title: BASS-II official experiment fact sheet (NASA)
description: Official NASA fact sheet for BASS / BASS-II: 100 fuel samples in three categories (flat samples; rod samples; one large solid sphere section); observed phenomena include flame shape vs oxygen concentration and flow speed; flame spread rate; pulsations; extinction.

title: NASA - Studying Combustion and Fire Safety
description: Official NASA overview of the ISS combustion research family: BASS; BASS-II; SoFIE-GEL; Saffire; Confined Combustion; BRE.

title: NTRS - BASS-II onboard sensor readings (technical paper)
description: NASA technical paper (NTRS 20150019858): onboard CSA-CP and CDM sensor readings during BASS-II; O2/CO2/CO analysis across geometry; flow velocity; initial oxygen conditions.

title: NASA - Entry Points to NASA Science Data (PSI 2.0)
description: Describes Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) 2.0: the public archive of completed physical-science reduced-gravity flight experiments; includes BASS-II data; imagery; publications.

title: NASA - Open Source Science Opportunities
description: States the PSI repository is the public archive for physical-science experiments performed on ISS/STS; supports NASA open-data policy.
